input.overview: The Lost World: Jurassic Park spreads the trip to San Diego across Raptor, Baby T-Rex, GPS, Mobile Lab, and Site B, while the dinosaur-brain drops build a separate Jeep-locked Multiball. Complete all five features to light the scoop for San Diego; Multiball can protect difficult shots, but do not assume every timed feature stacks with it.
input.simpleOverview: Raptor, Baby T-Rex, GPS, Mobile Lab, and Site B each have their own visible qualification. Complete all five to light the scoop for San Diego, while using the flashing dinosaur-brain drop targets to build the separate Jeep Multiball.
input.summary: Work on whichever of the five feature starts is safely available, and hit the flashing dinosaur-brain drop target when misses are controlled. Load three balls into the Jeep for Multiball, and after all five feature lamps are complete, shoot the flashing scoop for San Diego.

quickInfo.name: Raptor
quickInfo.summary: Hit the cycling lit RAPTOR targets, then hit another flashing Raptor target to begin two-ball play. Alternate the inner-orbit Jackpot with the target bank to finish.

quickInfo.name: Baby T-Rex
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the scoop for Lost World Mystery, then make two more scoop shots to hatch the egg. Return to the scoop three times during the timed feature.

quickInfo.name: GPS and Site B
quickInfo.summary: Spell GPS on both ramps and return to a flashing ramp to start GPS. Complete SITE B and hit another flashing target to start Site B.

quickInfo.name: Mobile Lab
quickInfo.summary: Complete T-R-E-X in the paired top lanes. Use each side’s flipper to move only that side’s lit lane, then make the displayed spinner count after the feature starts.

quickInfo.name: Jeep Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the flashing dinosaur-brain drop until all brain inserts are solid, then shoot the lit lock orbits so the snagger loads the Jeep.

steps.text: For Raptor, hit the cycling lit RAPTOR targets. After the bank flashes, hit another Raptor target to start two-ball play; shoot the inner orbit for a Jackpot, return to the targets, then collect the next inner-orbit Jackpot.
For Baby T-Rex, shoot the scoop for Lost World Mystery, then shoot it twice more to hatch the egg. Return to the scoop three times before the timed value expires.
For GPS, spell G-P-S on each ramp, then shoot either flashing ramp to start. Keep making the displayed number of ramp shots; later GPS rounds can require more than the first.
For Mobile Lab, use the flippers to complete T-R-E-X in the paired top lanes. After it starts, make the displayed spinner count to add a ball, then collect the displayed Jackpots.
For Site B, complete S-I-T-E-B and hit another flashing target. During the feature, move the lit position with the flippers and hit the adjacent target indicated by the display three times.
Between feature shots, hit the flashing dinosaur-brain drop until all brain inserts are solid. Shoot the lit lock orbits until the Jeep holds three balls and Multiball starts.
During Jeep Multiball, shoot the two ramps, then the two orbits, then the inner loop for the Super Jackpot.
Complete Raptor, Baby T-Rex, GPS, Mobile Lab, and Site B; starting a feature is not enough.
After the fifth feature completes and every major shot flashes, shoot the scoop.
Follow the flashing shots and display during San Diego; its complete scoring rules are not established well enough to publish a narrower route.

playfieldReferences.label: Lost World scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The upper scoop used by Lost World Mystery, Baby T-Rex, and the final San Diego start.

playfieldReferences.label: Brain lock-progress drop target
playfieldReferences.description: The central flashing drop target whose brain inserts build the Jeep locks.

playfieldReferences.label: Inner-orbit and Super Jackpot shot
playfieldReferences.description: The tight central loop used for Raptor Jackpots and the Jeep Multiball Super Jackpot.

cautions.issue: Later feature rounds increase some qualification or completion counts.
cautions.response: Read the display for the current GPS, Mobile Lab, and lock requirements instead of applying the first-round count to the whole game.

cautions.issue: The walkthrough briefly questions whether GPS stacks with Multiball.
cautions.response: GPS can remain active afterward, but stacking can vary by ROM or game state; do not assume a universal rule.
